title: Accordion
subtitle: The accordion sings, carrying its passion into the distance.

items.text: Port, Rayashki
The warm current of the ocean is a stranger to this place.
The long-silent dock seems to be pining for use, for visitors, to bustle once more with industry.
A lone figure stands there, resolute, unblinking.
Vila stretches out as she stands beside him. The scales on her wrists and ankles catch the light, shimmering against a white reflection in the water.

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: Do you really think it's a good idea to turn to Zeno for help?

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: We have drawn almost every man and woman from the mining facilities to get rid of the critters nesting around the port.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Most of the defense team were injured. Some lightly, but others got much worse. It will be weeks before they can return to duty.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: If an attack like the one at the rehearsal happens again, I'm not sure we will be able to protect ourselves.
His stance doesn't waver, but his face turns stiffly toward the abandoned mine far in the distance.
Kittiwakes screech as they swoop down over the vast white tundra.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: I know most of our people are frustrated with Zeno's arrival. But I expected better from you, Vila.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: People trust you, and they will follow you, but that doesn't make you right. Maybe you're still too young to see the dangers.

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: I might be wrong, but history is a long lesson in learning what is right through being unafraid to be wrong.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Sadly, we don't have time for trial and error.

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: And this is your excuse for making decisions for us against our will?

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: I will hold myself responsible for my decisions. In that, you have my word.
Their conversation reaches deadlock once again.
Fortunately, elsewhere, there are others with fewer and simpler burdens.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Today is the day of our welcome ceremony. Vila said, when the bell rings, the important people from the tortoise academy will arrive.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Everyone looks excited.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Nina has put on her best dress. I know she will be great on stage.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Pasono will duel with Pyotr. It's his duty to protect the princess.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: As for me, I got a new job from Mr. Evgeni.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: "Salute, shake hands, and give them the warmest welcome."
The child nods solemnly, aware of the weighty mission he must undertake.
The little standard-bearer stands ready to receive Rayashki's latest guests.

items.speaker: Qiqirn
items.text: Boawh ... arrh!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: What this? There are bubbles in the water!
The critter pops its head out of the water, two eyes staring out at the boy with bewilderment.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: We meet again, Qiqirn! Are you planting sunflowers under the water?

items.speaker: Qiqirn
items.text: *blows bubbles*

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Have you brought your friends?
Bubbles swell on the open surface of the water as more Qiqirns break up through the slurry of ice.
Though their peculiar appearances differ from one to the next, they all possess large, lamp-like eyes that look out and around with curiosity.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: One, two ... Oh, your friends also have six legs!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Look, they are wearing needlegrass and flat files on their legs.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Are you also here for the ceremony?
The child takes pride in his imagined duties.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Welcome, Qiqirn and friends!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Welcome to the prettiest town in all of the Arctic—Rayashki!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Please enjoy our song—
His cheeks flush as spirited childish voices reverberate in unison out into the sea ahead.
Seagulls take flight as a distant stern statue springs to life and rushes over.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Comrade Avgust, what are you doing?!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Oh? I'm welcoming the Qiqirn.
The child happily salutes the Qiqirns as they step onto the dock.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Get out of there. They are dangerous!

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Defense team, drive them away!

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: Wait! These are Qiqirn. They are not aggressive! They are just curious about us. The kids seem to like them.
The defense team moves swiftly and without hesitation.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Get rid of them.

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: As you command, comrade!
Sprays of bullets and bursts of flame disrupt the water's surface, following the Qiqirns as they dive in, one after another.
Alarms wail in the distance, but the Qiqirns are already long gone.
The children who came to see them are left on the ground, gripping their hats over their ears.

items.speaker: Nina
items.text: The Qiqirns are all gone. I think they don't like us anymore.

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: Comrade Evgeni ...

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Take the kids back to where they were, Comrade Vila. It was your duty to protect them.
His orders fizzle out as soon as they are said.

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: Maybe if we make the town a better place, more friends will come back.

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: Then they will also come back!

items.speaker: Pasono
items.text: That makes sense!
The researcher observes all this from a nearby vantage. Her notebook rustles with a sigh.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: The family of Qiqirn includes dozens of subspecies, but none of them are so greatly adapted to water as this. That is to say ...

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: They might also be affected by the ley energy under Rayashki.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: Pity that they were driven away. There was much we could have learned from them.
She looks up. A blanket of clouds obscures the sun, with only a few rays of light breaking through.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: *gasps*

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: The temperature here is rising much faster than expected, and much earlier in the season.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: I imagine if you asked the weather bureau, they would say this is just an "odd occurrence of unseasonable weather outside of expected ranges."
*boom*
The booming sound of cannon fire interrupts Windsong's train of thought.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: It's time. The Zeno investigators should be here any minute.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: I must stress again how important this ceremony could be for our future.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Our town's economy is facing a cliff, and I am sure each one of you has noticed the increased rationing.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: If we wish to take care of our people in the future and protect our friends and family from these frequent critter attacks, we need Zeno's support.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: So we will work with Zeno. Because we must!

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: The future of Rayashki is in our hands, so is the future of every comrade here.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: And we need the cooperation of every man and woman here.
His stare falls toward the Rusalka's vibrant tail.
After a pause, his target replies.

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: Zeno's ships are very fast, so, as soon as they appear on the horizon,

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: our ceremony will begin.

items.speaker: Choir Members
items.text: Understood.
The choir rises in unison, looking out at the pale blue horizon.
The sea responds placidly.
Salmon leap out from the water. Seagulls circling along the empty coastline.
Yet no sign of the anticipated ship appears.
The quiet expectations of the adults set the children to whisper.

items.speaker: Pasono
items.text: Zeno is late.

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: So late that Ms. Vila would say they were absent!

items.speaker: Nina
items.text: Do you think something bad happened to them?

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: What are they doing there?
No answers come, but a new event catches their attention.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Oh! Something is falling!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Light and soft, like a polar bear's hair!
Dark clouds press down on them, blocking out the final rays of sunlight.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Poor bear, losing all his hair.
Snowflakes flutter down across the gray sky.
Converging in the blustering wind, they fall towards the town.

items.speaker: Nina
items.text: Mmm?

items.speaker: Pasono
items.text: It's snow!

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: What?! How can there be snow in summer?

items.speaker: Pasono
items.text: Mm? Is this related to the strange thing Avgust said earlier?

items.speaker: Nina
items.text: If so, I'm happy that these aren't stones or a dark cloud's spit.
The children huddle near Avgust, astonished by the accuracy of his predictions.

items.speaker: Pasono
items.text: Avgust, I can't believe it! You were never right before!

items.speaker: Nina
items.text: *shivers* Oh, oh, it's chilly. The snow is biting against my skin.

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: I'm sorry, Avgust. I shouldn't call you a liar.
He lowers his head hesitantly.

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: But will Rayashki really get into trouble?
A gentle hand nudges Pyotr, a motion learned from someone older and wiser.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Pyotr, we will not be defeated, not by clouds, or bears.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Look!

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: Mr. Tortoise is walking very slowly.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: But no one has left their position.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: For Rayashki.

items.speaker: Avgust
items.text: You little swans must go back to your lake too! Go as fast as you can!

items.speaker: Nina
items.text: We will!

items.speaker: Pyotr
items.text: Don't forget your own job, Avgust!
The children return to their positions and ready themselves.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: So, this milky white line is this snowstorm.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: The average temperature in Rayashki has reached its highest point in the last five years, which, together with the abnormally rich air moisture, has produced an unseasonal and odd kind of snow.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: The weather forecast was wrong; ley lines were right!
Windsong can't hide her excitement.
She leans up on a wall some distance from the event, her pen flying across page after page of notes.
Until she is compelled to snap back to reality.

items.speaker: Windsong
items.text: Mm?
The assembly before her has barely moved.
The snow claims more territory by the minute.
Over sea and land, piling up on the railings, and rising over boots, large and small.
A distant foghorn accompanies the sight of a flag piercing up into the horizon. Zeno arrives at last.

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Everyone, listen!

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Our ceremony will begin.

items.speaker: Residents
items.text: As you command, comrade!

items.speaker: Evgeni
items.text: Music, please!

items.speaker: Residents
items.text: "Let go of yesterday, let it fade away."

items.speaker: Residents
items.text: "Each step paints a brand-new day."

items.speaker: Residents
items.text: "Don't look behind, no shadows will be seen in the daylight."

items.speaker: Residents
items.text: "Under brighter skies, we leave on our journey."
The steamship pulls into their rudimentary harbor, but no further movement follows.
A porthole opens, but no voice comes out, no sound whatsoever beyond the lapping waves.
A letter flutters out toward the anxious crowd.
It's a pleasure to speak to you all, our valued friends in Rayashki.
On behalf of Zeno Arms Academy, I am here to announce the details of the "Zeno-Rayashki Cooperation Agreement."
As many of you have expected, a squad of armed troops will soon be sent to aid you with the critter problem.

However, having given it careful consideration, we have decided that the town of Rayashki is no longer viable for our continued support and must be abandoned. We advise that all residents prepare to be transferred to a new post, immediately.
Thank you for your cooperation.

items.speaker: Vila
items.text: What?!
